title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
tagline: The Kessel Run. One full plate.
about: Young Han Solo joins a crew of thieves and meets Chewbacca and Lando on the way.
cue: Serve the snacks when Han sits down at the card table with Lando.

Compliments of the captain. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Laser issue, fleet standard. Form G-12, sheet 2 of 2. 2018. Crew notes: The Kessel Run. Han meeting Chewbacca in the pit. A really good feeling about this.

Lando's Falcon GalleySolo: A Star Wars StoryThe Kessel Run. One full plate.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersSabacc rosemary nuts and olivesWarm roasted almonds and cashews with rosemary and smoked salt, mixed olivesHow to make it150g almonds150g cashews1 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp chopped rosemary1 tsp smoked salt150g green olives150g kalamata olivesToss the almonds and cashews with the oil, rosemary and smoked salt on a tray.Roast at 180°C until fragrant. Serve warm in one bowl beside a second bowl of mixed olives.Corellia street dumplingsPan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with chilli oil and black vinegarHow to make it400g pork mince1/4 small wombok, finely shredded1 tbsp grated ginger1 tsp salt24 dumpling wrappers2 tbsp oil3 tbsp chilli oil3 tbsp black vinegarMix the pork with the wombok, ginger and salt.Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.Fry in oil until crisp underneath, add a splash of water, cover and steam for 5 minutes.Serve with chilli oil and black vinegar.MainsVandor lodge roast pork knucklePork knuckle roasted until the crackling blisters, with buttered potatoesHow to make it2 pork knuckles1 brown onion, halved2 bay leaves1 tsp caraway seeds1 tbsp sea salt flakes800g potatoes30g butter2 tbsp chopped parsley500g sauerkraut2 tbsp wholegrain mustardSimmer the knuckles with the onion, bay leaves and caraway seeds for an hour and a half.Lift out, pat very dry, score and rub with salt.Roast at 220°C until the crackling blisters.Boil the potatoes and toss with butter and parsley. Warm the sauerkraut with a little cooking liquid.Serve with wholegrain mustard.First Light duck with cherry and portThe glittering party on Dryden Vos's yacht, the First LightHow to make itAs written, serves 4Duck breasts scored and rendered until the skin crackles, sliced pink over silky celeriac purée with a cherry and port sauce and crisp kale.Simmer a peeled, chopped celeriac in milk and water for 20 minutes, drain and blitz with 40g butter.Score 4 duck breasts, start skin side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat for 8 minutes, then flip and roast at 200°C for 6 minutes.Rest.Pour off most fat, add 100ml port, 200g pitted cherries and 150ml stock and reduce until glossy.Bake kale leaves with oil until crisp.SweetsCoaxium popping candy chocolate barkDark chocolate bark with popping candy and freeze-dried raspberriesHow to make it300g dark chocolate2 sachets of popping candy15g freeze-dried raspberries1/2 tsp sea salt flakesLine a tray with baking paper. Melt the chocolate over barely simmering water, stirring until smooth.Spread thin on the tray. While still soft, scatter with popping candy, raspberries and salt.Set in the fridge for 30 minutes, then snap into jagged shards.DrinksLando's cape cocktailBourbon, honey syrup and orange bitters stirred over a big ice cubeHow to make it3 tbsp honey3 tbsp warm water240ml bourbon8 dashes of orange bitters1 orange1 bag iceStir the honey into the warm water to make a syrup.For each drink, stir the bourbon, syrup and bitters with ice, then strain over one big ice cube.Twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
